prompt: In some parts of the world, many famous people are regarded as role models and they are having an increasing influence on the young. Is this a positive or negative development?
essay:
It is often argued that famous people are increasingly becoming role models for young individuals in many parts of the world. Although some celebrities can have a positive influence, I strongly believe that this is a negative development because they may create unrealistic expectations about success and encourage young people to imitate inappropriate behaviour.

The primary reason why I consider this a negative development is that famous people can create unrealistic expectations among young people. Celebrities and influencers frequently display expensive clothes, luxury cars and costly holidays, particularly on social media. As young viewers are exposed to such lifestyles on a regular basis, they may begin to associate success with wealth, popularity and material possessions. For example, a teenager who constantly watches influencers showing expensive products may feel dissatisfied with his or her ordinary lifestyle and may even spend money unnecessarily to imitate them. As a result, excessive admiration of celebrities can encourage materialism rather than realistic personal goals.

Another concern is that young people may imitate inappropriate behaviour displayed by famous individuals. This is because adolescents are often influenced by people whom they admire, especially when those personalities have a large online following. If a celebrity promotes irresponsible behaviour, unhealthy habits or offensive language, some young viewers may consider such actions acceptable. For instance, teenagers may copy dangerous online challenges performed by popular influencers simply because these activities attract attention. Consequently, the influence of famous people can affect young people's behaviour and values in undesirable ways.

In conclusion, although some famous people can inspire young individuals to work hard, I strongly believe that their growing influence is a negative development overall because it can promote unrealistic lifestyles and inappropriate behaviour.
